entries.en: V, I have a job – the urgent kind. Someone is yanking my friends' drones out of the sky.
entries.ro: V, am o treabă – din alea urgente. Cineva îmi trage dronele prietenilor din cer.

entries.en: Check out the coordinates, find out who is responsible. The details are attached.
entries.ro: Verifică coordonatele, află cine e responsabil. Detaliile sunt atașate.
